tables.title: Distribution of coal, November 1945 - February 1946
tables.source_note: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Coal Board.
tables.notes: A bracket in the original groups Ceramics through Others in the December Allocated column and gives a single figure 65 for the group (printed beside the bracket); the individual rows show '-'. In the February columns a bracket groups Machinery and Shipping (allocated 14.0 and 5.0) with a single delivered figure 26.2, placed here in the Machinery row; the Shipping delivered cell is blank for that reason. Blank cells in the Chemical industry row are blank in the original.
tables.totals_check: Summing the rows (Chemical subitems included, 'Chemical industry' header row empty; the December 65 counted once for the bracketed group; the February 26.2 counted once): December Allocated 1066.0 (printed 1066.0, agree); December Delivered 1391.8 (printed 1391.8, agree); January Allocated 1451.0 (printed 1451.0, agree); January Delivered 1561.7 (printed 1561.7, agree); February Allocated 1491.0 (printed 1491.0, agree); February Delivered 1604.0 (printed 1604.0, agree).
tables.ocr_check: OCR had several misreads (Mine use 228.0/228.4 for 225.0/225.4, Fertilizer 28, Others 82.6/70.7, Allied Powers 69, Foodstuffs 24.3/21.0, Lime 88/25.0, Ceramics 48.3, Total 1804.0, and placed 65 wrongly); column sums confirm the values transcribed here.

tables.title: Stocks of crude rubber, 20 February 1946
tables.totals_check: Rows: all six row totals agree with their regional figures. Columns: Hokkaido 320 (agree); Kyushu 5,062 (agree); Shikoku 8,935 (agree); Honshu 5,192+3,392+3,127+2,263+1,152+596=15,722 versus printed 15,782 (DISAGREE by 60); Total column 14,455+5,195+3,740+3,595+2,458+596=30,039 (agree). Regional totals 320+5,062+8,935+15,782=30,099 vs printed 30,039.
warnings: Honshu column total printed 15,782 but the items sum to 15,722; the grand total 30,039 matches the items, so the printed Honshu total is probably a misprint (or misread).
